verdict.rationale: Reclaim documents Scheduling Links with 'smart meeting controls' and calendar-level buffers: Travel Time before and after events with a location, and Decompression Time after meetings. That covers the buffer element in part. Nothing documents the other protections this story names. Missing for 10: booking-link-specific before/after buffers, minimum-notice settings, daily booking caps, date-range booking windows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
